pages.text: Ten relics of the Old Ones are scattered around the world. Each one has $(bold)unique acquisition conditions$() (mostly events / exploration / chance), and can be smelted into a matching material. Click each relic to see how to obtain and use it:$(li)$(l:relic_rlyeh_call)The Call of R'lyeh$() → Ashen Ink$(li)$(l:relic_nyarlathotep_desire)Nyarlathotep's Desire$()$(li)$(l:relic_yellow_king_remnant)Vestige of the King in Yellow$() → Hastur's Malice$(li)$(l:relic_nicholas_blessing)Nicholas's Blessing$() → Life Impulse$(li)$(l:relic_yog_sothoth_gate_key)Yog-Sothoth's Gate Key$()$(li)$(l:relic_gheloth_remains)Gheloth Remains$() → Gheloth's Blood$(li)$(l:relic_echo_of_the_void)Echo of the Void$()$(li)$(l:relic_astral_anchor)Astral Anchor$()$(li)$(l:relic_nexus_of_spacetime)Spacetime Nexus Core$()$(li)$(l:relic_durandal_shard)Shattered Blade of Durandal$() → Molten Durandal
